SELECT count( oi.SOU_ITEM_ID ) ext_order_count, oi.SOU_ITEM_ID, oi.ROUND FROM scc_sou_order_item oi WHERE (oi.SOU_ITEM_ID, oi.ROUND) IN
(#{item.souItemId}, #{item.round})
AND oi.ORDER_STATUS = 'SUBMISSION' GROUP BY oi.SOU_ITEM_ID, oi.ROUND

SELECT project.SOU_NO, vendor.VENDOR_CODE, vendor.VENDOR_NAME, order_item.* FROM scc_sou_order_item order_item LEFT JOIN scc_sou_item sou_item on sou_item.sou_item_id = order_item.sou_item_id LEFT JOIN scc_sou_inq_item inq_item on inq_item.sou_item_id = order_item.sou_item_id LEFT JOIN scc_sou_inq_order_item inq_order_item on inq_order_item.order_item_id = order_item.order_item_id LEFT JOIN scc_sou_project project on order_item.PROJECT_ID = project.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN scc_sou_inq_project inq_project on order_item.PROJECT_ID = inq_project.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN scc_sou_vendor vendor on vendor.PROJECT_ID = order_item.PROJECT_ID AND vendor.VENDOR_ID = order_item.VENDOR_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND project.SOU_TYPE = 'inq' AND project.PROJECT_STATUS = 'PRICE_END' AND order_item.SELECT_STATUS = 'WIN' AND inq_order_item.FIX_PRICING != 'Y' AND inq_order_item.HAS_FIX_PRICE != 'Y' AND inq_order_item.LATEST_PRICE_TAG = 'Y' AND inq_item.HAS_CLOSE = 'N'
AND sou_item.ORG_OU_ID = #{orgOuId}
AND project.SOU_NO LIKE concat('%', concat(#{souNo}, '%'))
AND order_item.ITEM_CODE LIKE concat('%', concat(#{itemCode}, '%'))
AND ( project.CREATED_BY LIKE concat('%', concat(#{buyerUsername}, '%')) OR project.CREATED_FULL_NAME LIKE concat('%', concat(#{buyerUsername}, '%')) )
AND inq_project.CREATE_USER_ORG_OU_ID = #{createUserOrgOuId}
order by project.SOU_NO desc
